Hey there survivors!

We had several reports from players in Steam, on our Discord and even on Reddit about balancing issues. We investigated your feedback carefully and knew we had to find a solution for this.

we have summarized the most important points for you and would like to explain why many questions and inconsistencies have arisen. Many players have noted. they are not having enough water or food available. Most of the time this problem happened either at the beginning of a new round or after a drought, so we have modified several systems.

Settlers now survive longer without food or water

we implemented this in order to make it easier for the player to recover from situations where no food or water is left. This often caused the settlement to completely fall apart.
Now it should be easier to recover from dire straits.


Cultivated fields and orchards wither away much slower during a drought

Crops on cultivated fields and orchards withered away completely during a drought.
This often caused an entire harvest to be lost and created a very hard setup for the future of your settlement. Your crops had to regrow entirely from scratch and produced no food for the next couple of seasons. 
Now all crops only lose some of their food amount during a drought, setting the food production back but not destroying it outright.


We fixed a bug concerning settler homes

It was sometimes the case that settlers would not search for homes, even though there were homes available. This has been fixed.
We also improved when and how settlers look for a home. If a settler dies and was living in a house, homeless settlers and settlers that are living in shelters will now try to move into that house. The same is done when a house is upgraded.

We made it, Survivors!

The Closed Beta gave us a deeper insight into your gaming behaviour and showed us early on possible optimizations and frequently mentioned wishes. It was a good opportunity for us to collect feedback and to adjust the further development steps with regard to the upcoming Early Access. Savegames
During Early Access we can not guarantee savegames to work across updates. We will do our best to avoid broken savegames and ensure compatibility, but there will be cases where we will have to make a clean cut and break support for older files.
Closed Beta savegames are no longer compatible with the Early Access release version and can not be loaded from the Main Menu.

UI
The Statistics View is currently very rudimentary and not fully implemented. Enhancing this view as well as giving more insights into the state of your settlement will be part of further updates. The first of this kind is planned as a sidetrack in May.
We translated the game into several languages right from the start. However, due to the dynamic nature of the game and our fast iteration cycles, some translations may be outdated or wrong. If this is the case we are happy if you could point out any translation issues.
Parts of the User Interface are subject to change due to user feedback and internal decisions to improve the overall experience.

Features
The game currently features a first prototype of our Side Mission system. This system will be overhauled as one of the first steps during the Early Access. Our target is to better integrate Side Missions into the game flow, to improve concerning feedback and to embed them into small narrative snippets around your settlement with more challenging goals.
At Early Access release the game features all core mechanics in a challenging and intriguing sandbox mode as well as some mid-game features like Electricity. Lategame content is our main focus and will be enhanced during the further development of the game.
Local Expeditions are part of our first Early Access milestone. However, small fractures of this feature might already be visible in the game and might lead to confusion.

Bugs
The logisticians of Markets currently ignore the restrictions set on the building that limit which resources should be stored in this building.
If the Game Time is paused the Task Completed window of a finished mission on the bottom of the screen is delayed until the Game Time is unpaused.
